---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a change to a quality workflow or an operator capability
labels: enhancement
---

## Need

Who needs this, and what task are they trying to complete?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the observable result and how it fits existing quality workflows.

## Acceptance

Describe how we can verify the outcome, including relevant permission, audit, and data boundaries.

## Alternatives and related work

Describe the current workaround and link related issues, decisions, or residuals.

Use placeholders and synthetic examples. Do not include customer or installation data.
